high_level_description: This image is a social media post from the Instagram account @SeekersOfTheCosmos, featuring a black-and-white photograph of Werner Heisenberg, a renowned physicist, on the left side. The right side of the image contains a colorful, abstract illustration of quantum physics concepts, such as atomic structures and energy waves. The text overlay at the top reads "THE BIRTH OF QUANTUM PHYSICS," indicating the theme of the post.
